prompt: Who is the most recent female middle school student to represent China in the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) contest?
answer: The most recent was **Yan Binwei (严彬玮)**, who represented China at the **2020 IMO**. She was a senior at the **High School Affiliated to Nanjing Normal University** and was the only girl on China’s six-member team that year.
